mechanism: Both drugs can cause QT prolongation and potentially increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias; additive nephrotoxicity risk with zoledronic acid's renal effects combined with fluoroquinolone-related renal stress.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, potassium) regularly; ensure adequate hydration before zoledronic acid infusion; consider alternative antibiotic if prolonged QT interval present at baseline.
